text.description_html:
Bommer LB4391C-400-630, 4" x 4" x 1/4" Radius Heavy Duty Stainless Steel Spring Hinge

Packaged complete with a Pair (2) Single Action Spring Door Hinges, Tension Adjusting Tool, Locking Pins plus #12 x 1-1/4" Wood Screws and #12-24 x 1/2" machine screws. Utilizes ANSI template screw hole pattern for use with wood or metal doors.

Bommer stainless steel spring hinges are UL Listed for fire door applications, certified Grade 1 (highest grade) for 1 million cycles and made in the USA. Pivot point aligns with residential butt hinges gage .123 to .134

The included Tension Tool is use to adjust spring tension. The Locking Pins hold the Spring in tension after it is set. These adjustable tension spring hinges allow you to determine how much closing force you apply to the door (how hard/fast the door self closes). The internal spring is coated in plastic that helps rust prevention.

Specifications for Bommer LB4391C-400-630 Stainless Spring Hinge

  • Hinge Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Height: 4"
  • Width: 4"
  • Corners: 1/4" Radius
  • Gauge of Metal: .130 (Heavy Duty)
  • Number of Holes: 8
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Wood Screws: #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2"
  • Adjustable Spring Torque
  • Non-Handed
  • UL Listed R-4667 653M for fire door applications.
  • Full Mortise - ANSI K81071F
  • BHMA Certified Grade 1 for 1 million cycles.
  • Bommer LB4391C-400 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Sold as a pair (2 Hinges).



** This item is Discontinued. See available Spring Hinges.
